meta.title: Agent work protocol
meta.description: Injects a portable work protocol into every agent's system prompt: a visible task line, one-pass request refinement, semantic skill routing, forced clarification with concrete triggers, strict mode for high-requirement work, and a delivery self-check. Each section can be switched off in the bundle config. This is model guidance, not a hard gate; it writes nothing to your profile and applies to agents of this profile only.
